glosses: to be incapable of any further reaction or bond, to be saturated

examples.text: Dabei werden die Doppelbindungen in den Fettsäure-Ketten der Fettmoleküle mit Wasserstoff abgesättigt
examples.translation: Here the double bonds in the fatty-acid chain of the fat molecules are made incapable of any further bond with hydrogen.
examples.english: Here the double bonds in the fatty-acid chain of the fat molecules are made incapable of any further bond with hydrogen.

examples.text: Betrachtet man jedoch das freie, nicht proteingebundene Molekül und minimiert dessen Geometrie im isolierten Zustand, so wird es eine Konformation annehmen, in der sich die Wasserstoffbrücken intramolekular absättigen […].
examples.translation: But if you look at the free not protein bound molecule and minimize its geometry in isolated state, it will conform so that the hydrogen bonds saturate each other intramolecularly[…].
examples.english: But if you look at the free not protein bound molecule and minimize its geometry in isolated state, it will conform so that the hydrogen bonds saturate each other intramolecularly[…].

examples.text: Zuerst gibt es — beim Kleinkind — nur Primärverstärker, d. h. Situationen, die Vitalbedürfnisse stillen und diejenigen Verhaltensformen wiederholt auftreten lassen, die solche Bedürfnisse absättigen.
examples.translation: At first there are — with the toddler — only primary amplifiers, i. e. situations that quench vital needs and let the kind of behavior repeated, that satisfies those needs.
examples.english: At first there are — with the toddler — only primary amplifiers, i. e. situations that quench vital needs and let the kind of behavior repeated, that satisfies those needs.
